plan.archetype: Flexible burst damage into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Secure efficient damage, poison scaling, and reliable block. Upgrade key attacks and Neutralize. Cross the 160-HP stun threshold quickly; respect ringing’s one-card turns.
plan.summary: Build around the chosen pack. Prioritize immediate damage, then poison scaling, draw, and defense. Remove Strikes after replacing their damage. Take supported elites, use potions against major losses, and upgrade when healing is unnecessary.
